_help.maxTitleLength: Max characters in a request title (8-128).
_help.maxDetailsLength: Max characters in the details text (0 disables details).
_help.maxActiveRequestsPerPlayer: Open requests a player can have at once (0 = unlimited).
_help.maxObjectiveEntries: Different items a request can ask for (1-32).
_help.maxStacksPerObjective: Max stacks per requested item (0 = unlimited).
_help.harvestRequiresObjective: Harvest requests must list at least one item.
_help.maxAcceptors: Players who can accept the same request (0 = unlimited).
_help.allowAcceptOwnRequest: Let a player accept their own request.
_help.operatorsCanRemoveAny: Operators can delete any request (rewards go back to the creator).
_help.broadcastNewRequests: Announce new requests in chat to every player.
_help.playSounds: Play a sound on board events.
_help.defaultStyle: Board look for players who have not picked one: MODERN (sticky notes) or FANTASY (old quest board).
_help.categories: Enable or disable each category (at least one stays enabled).
_help.rewards.enabled: Allow rewards (items from the creator's inventory only).
_help.rewards.autoWithdraw: Take reward items from the creator's inventory when the request is posted. If false, rewards are only shown and handed over manually.
_help.rewards.autoDispatch: When the creator closes the request, split the withdrawn rewards evenly between everyone who accepted it. Ignored if autoWithdraw is false. If false, rewards return to the creator.
_help.rewards.splitMode: EVEN: equal shares. PRORATA: shares in proportion to what each participant declared in their contribution (participants who declared nothing get nothing; equal shares if nobody declared anything).
_help.rewards.remainderMode: Who gets the leftover items when the split is uneven: RANDOM, FIRST_COME (earliest acceptors) or CREATOR (back to the creator).
_help.rewards.textEnabled: Allow a short text reward (e.g. "a free house build"), shown on the request. Not handed out automatically.
_help.rewards.maxTextLength: Max characters of the text reward (8-200).
_help.editing.enabled: Let the creator edit their request after posting it (Edit button in the request view).
_help.editing.category / title / details / obj: Which parts of a request can be edited. Changing rewards returns the old withdrawn items and takes the new ones. The time limit can be changed, added or removed.
_help.contributions.creatorStock: The creator can say how many of each item they already have; it counts in the progress.
_help.contributions.creatorCanAdjust: The creator can correct each participant's contribution (marked as confirmed).
_help.contributions.enabled: Players who accepted a request can say how many of each requested item they have, so everyone sees what is still missing. Informative only: nothing is taken from their inventory.
_help.timeLimit.enabled: Allow requests with a time limit; they disappear when it runs out and rewards go back to the creator.
_help.timeLimit.maxMinutes: Longest allowed time limit in minutes (0 = no maximum).
